_readme: HOW TO UPDATE: add, edit or delete records in the 'items' list below. Copy an existing record (from { to }), keep the commas between records, and keep the quotation marks. Fields: id (unique, no spaces), type (handbook | course | practice | opportunity), tag (small label above the title), title, desc (short description), owner (school or unit), meta (small label at bottom right), link (optional page address), sample (true = shows a SAMPLE badge; set to false or remove only once the record is approved SP information). Validate your edit at https://jsonlint.com before saving.
